SlayTheDungeon:PressureIndicator.NAME: Pressure Indicator
DESCRIPTIONS: Displays the party's current Stress. Taking unblocked damage also inflicts Stress. (Current Virtue chance: %1$d%%, Affliction chance: %2$d%%.)

SlayTheDungeon:BrightnessIndicator.NAME: Brightness Indicator
SlayTheDungeon:BrightnessIndicator.FLAVOR: The light has not yet faded.
DESCRIPTIONS: Displays the current Brightness. Higher Brightness reduces damage and Stress taken, but also reduces gold and the chance of positive effects. (Current: incoming damage %1$d%%, Stress gain %2$d%%, positive effect chance %3$+d%%, gold gained %4$d%%.)

SlayTheDungeon:BrokenKey.NAME: Broken Key
SlayTheDungeon:BrokenKey.FLAVOR: A beast whispers beneath the man.
DESCRIPTIONS: Each turn, the 1st, 3rd, 5th... card you play costs 0, and the 2nd, 4th, 6th... card costs 1 more [E].

SlayTheDungeon:FleetFlorin.NAME: Fleet Florin
DESCRIPTIONS: Gold gained after combat and from chests is increased by 10.

SlayTheDungeon:BullsEyeBandana.NAME: Bull's Eye Bandana
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of combat, apply 1 slaythedungeon:Mark to ALL enemies.

SlayTheDungeon:HuntersTalons.NAME: Hunter's Talons
DESCRIPTIONS: Cards you play have a
% chance to be played an additional time.

SlayTheDungeon:HolyOrders.NAME: Holy Orders
SlayTheDungeon:HolyOrders.FLAVOR: In the name of the light.
DESCRIPTIONS: Maximum slaythedungeon:Brightness is increased by 20.

SlayTheDungeon:ResurrectionsCollar.NAME: Resurrection's Collar
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of turn 3, heal 10 HP. At the start of turn 5, lose 8 HP.

SlayTheDungeon:LuckyTalisman.NAME: Lucky Talisman
SlayTheDungeon:LuckyTalisman.FLAVOR: The dead have no use for it.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of combat, gain 2 Dexterity.

SlayTheDungeon:HellsHairpin.NAME: Hell's Hairpin
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of combat, apply 6 slaythedungeon:Bleed to ALL enemies.

SlayTheDungeon:ScoutingWhistle.NAME: Scouting Whistle
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each turn, add a Hound to your hand.

SlayTheDungeon:GunslingersBuckle.NAME: Gunslinger's Buckle
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you take damage, gain 1 slaythedungeon:Riposte.

SlayTheDungeon:DirgeForTheDevoured.NAME: Dirge For The Devoured
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of combat, add a Finale to your hand. It costs 0 this combat and has Retain.

SlayTheDungeon:BerserkMask.NAME: Berserk Mask
SlayTheDungeon:BerserkMask.FLAVOR: A broken body, an unbroken will.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of combat, gain 3 Strength. The chance of positive effects triggering is reduced by 10%.

SlayTheDungeon:RampartShield.NAME: Rampart Shield
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of every 3rd turn, gain 10 Block.

SlayTheDungeon:WrathfulHat.NAME: Wrathful Hat
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to a random enemy 3 times.

SlayTheDungeon:DemonsCauldron.NAME: Demon's Cauldron
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, lose 5 slaythedungeon:Brightness.

SlayTheDungeon:BlasphemousVial.NAME: Blasphemous Vial
SlayTheDungeon:BlasphemousVial.FLAVOR: Beneath the beak, cure and poison.
DESCRIPTIONS: slaythedungeon:Plague no longer halves at the end of the enemy's turn, but also deals no damage.

SlayTheDungeon:VenomousVial.NAME: Venomous Vial
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, trigger the Poison or slaythedungeon:Plague effect of a random enemy.

SlayTheDungeon:SacredScroll.NAME: Sacred Scroll
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, gain 5 slaythedungeon:Brightness.
